$comment: awesome-ui component registry — one entry per ledger component (llms.txt 0..N). category is a single taxonomy id; tags are multi-value facet ids. Validated by tools/check_registry.py. Keep in sync with llms.txt on every new component batch.

components.name: UiIcon
components.desc: Zero-dependency, accessible SVG icon system shared by all three stacks.

components.name: ChatPromptInput
components.desc: Multi-modal auto-resizing prompt input with file/image attachments, submit/stop state, and an optional bottom chips row (`chips: [{ id, label, icon?, active? }]`, event `chip`).

components.name: StreamMarkdown
components.desc: High-performance streaming markdown renderer with syntax highlighting, code copy, and pulsing cursor.

components.name: ThinkingBlock
components.desc: DeepSeek R1 / OpenAI o1 reasoning chain accordion with shimmer timer, smooth collapse, optional step timeline (`steps: [{ id, label, durationMs? }]` with connectors and duration badges), and a collapsed one-line summary (running step pulses amber; finished shows last step + duration).

components.name: ToolCallBadge
components.desc: Agent tool invocation badge with running/success/error status and argument/output inspection drawer.

components.name: SourcesCitation
components.desc: Perplexity/RAG style search source citations with domain pills, snippets, and grid layout.

components.name: AutoScrollAnchor
components.desc: Smart auto-scrolling anchor that smoothly follows streaming output and pauses on user back-scroll.

components.name: ArtifactCanvas
components.desc: Claude Artifacts-style split-pane live preview with code view and sandboxed iframe rendering.

components.name: MessageActionToolbar
components.desc: Assistant message footer toolbar with copy, regenerate, thumbs feedback, and branch pagination.

components.name: PromptChips
components.desc: Suggested follow-up prompts and chips for interactive guidance.

components.name: ThemeToggle
components.desc: 3-state theme mode switcher (Auto/Light/Dark) with system color-scheme and time perception.

components.name: StatusIndicator
components.desc: Node/Service health status badge with live ping ms and breathing glow.

components.name: ContextUsageBadge
components.desc: LLM token usage telemetry badge with tiered threshold colors (<70% green, 70-90% amber, >=90% rose) and token breakdown popover.

components.name: ModelSelector
components.desc: Model routing switcher with instant search, provider badges, context window size tags, and dropdown drawer.

components.name: RoadmapTimeline
components.desc: Trail/Roadmap milestone progression with diamond pins, 8-stage color palette, and completion states.

components.name: KnowledgeDrawer
components.desc: Sliding knowledge graph drawer with dependency badges, stage color accent, and primary action CTA.

components.name: HomepageDashboard
components.desc: fenced/copy-paste homelab/startpage dashboard inspired by gethomepage/homepage — grouped service cards, collapsible groups, live clock, instant search filter, status dots/pills, version footer.

components.name: CodeBlock
components.desc: Standalone code card with language badge, filename, one-click copy feedback, optional line numbers, and max-height scrolling. All code text is entity-escaped.

components.name: TypingIndicator
components.desc: AI composing / first-token-wait loading indicator with staggered bouncing dots or pulse variant, three sizes, and role="status" accessibility.

components.name: ChatMessageRow
components.desc: Conversation bubble row with user/assistant/system roles, avatar (custom or icon fallback), sender name, and timestamp. All text entity-escaped; vanilla supports both `content` attribute and property.

components.name: CommandPalette
components.desc: Cmd+K command palette with instant search filter, group headers, keyboard navigation (arrows/Enter/Escape), icon and shortcut hints, backdrop dismiss, and a bottom shortcut hint bar (Navigate / Select / Close kbd hints).

components.name: ToastStack
components.desc: Global notification stack with success/error/warning/info types, manual dismiss, auto-dismiss (default 4000ms, `duration="0"` disables), aria-live announcements, and a bottom countdown bar that shrinks with remaining time (hover pauses, leave resumes).

components.name: ChatSessionList
components.desc: Conversation history sidebar with active highlight, hover-reveal delete, keyboard-selectable rows, empty state, session count badge, collapsible `group` headers (ungrouped sessions go to a "Recent" bucket), and a bottom user card (`user: { name, email?, avatarUrl? }`, event `user-click`).

components.name: DiffViewer
components.desc: AI code-edit diff view with add/remove/context line highlighting, +/- summary counts, dual old/new line numbers, filename/language badges, multi-file tab bar (`files: [{ filename, language?, lines }]`, per-tab +/- counts), and long-context hunk folding ("⋯ N unchanged lines" rows expand in place, `contextSize` default 3; legacy `lines` API kept).

components.name: ToolApprovalCard
components.desc: Agent human-in-the-loop permission prompt with Approve/Reject actions, low/high risk tiers, JSON args preview, and resolved-state badges.

components.name: FileAttachmentList
components.desc: Prompt attachment chips with per-type icons (image/code/file), B/KB/MB size formatting, and removable chips. Pairs with ChatPromptInput.

components.name: StreamingProgressBar
components.desc: Generation progress bar with determinate (clamped 0-100) and indeterminate pulse modes, streaming/done/error status colors, and role="progressbar".

components.name: EmptyState
components.desc: Zero-result placeholder with icon, title, description, and optional CTA action button. All text entity-escaped.

components.name: AgentStepTimeline
components.desc: Multi-step agent execution trace with pending/running/done/error status icons, tinted connectors, and duration badges.

components.name: PromptTemplateGrid
components.desc: Prompt template card grid with tag badges and hover Use action; clicking a card emits the full template including its prompt text.

components.name: AgentTaskChecklist
components.desc: Agent task plan with done/total progress counter, status icons (done strike-through, active spinner), and optional toggle interaction.

components.name: PricingTable
components.desc: SaaS pricing table with 3-column plan cards, highlighted recommended plan (ring + "Most popular" badge), price/period, check-marked feature list, and per-plan CTA.

components.name: StatCard
components.desc: Dashboard stat card with label, large value, signed delta % (emerald/red), optional zero-dependency SVG sparkline (from `trend` array), and optional icon.

components.name: DataTable
components.desc: Data table with sortable columns (clickable headers), right-aligned numeric cells, hover-revealed row actions, optional multi-select with floating batch-action bar, and empty state.

components.name: AgentRunLog
components.desc: Agent execution log with status timeline (pending/running/done/error icons + connector line), duration chip, click-to-expand dark terminal detail block, and done/total counter.

components.name: AuthForm
components.desc: Sign-in / sign-up card with SSO provider buttons (image or letter fallback), "or" divider, email/password fields (plus optional name in signup mode), inline error alert, loading spinner, and footer link.

components.name: SettingsPanel
components.desc: Two-column settings shell — anchor nav (icon + title, `aria-current` on the active section) beside a card whose rows show label/description/value plus an inline action link, with an optional footer save row and loading state.

components.name: OnboardingChecklist
components.desc: Activation checklist with done/total counter, progress bar, strikethrough completed tasks, per-task action link, and an all-done celebration state.

components.name: UpgradePromptCard
components.desc: Usage-based upsell card with threshold-colored progress bar (emerald <70%, amber <90%, red ≥90%), used/limit formatting, feature checklist, and upgrade CTA. Clamps to 0–100% and guards a zero limit.

components.name: ConfirmDialog
components.desc: Destructive-action guard with danger/warning/default tones, optional type-to-confirm gate (`requireText`), loading lock that disables both buttons and ignores Esc/backdrop, Esc + backdrop close. Renders nothing while `isOpen` is false.

components.name: ShortcutsOverlay
components.desc: Keyboard cheat sheet with grouped shortcut sections, kbd keycaps, live search over labels and keys, Esc/backdrop close. Accepts either `groups` or a flat `shortcuts` list bucketed by `item.group` (fallback "General").

components.name: FileDropzone
components.desc: Drag-and-drop upload zone with click and keyboard activation, `accept` type filtering (extensions, exact MIME, `type/*` wildcards), `maxSizeMb` size guard, per-file rows with formatted sizes and remove buttons, and an inline `role="alert"` error line. Exports `matchesAccept(file, accept)` and `formatBytes` helpers.

components.name: NotificationCenter
components.desc: Inbox panel with unread badge ("N new"), All/Unread filter row with inline counts, per-item read state, "Mark all read", typed icon chips (info/success/warning/error), an empty state and an optional preferences gear (show-prefs-button → open-preferences). Renders nothing while `isOpen` is false.

components.name: CommentThread
components.desc: Nested discussion built from a flat `comments` array linked by `parentId` (auto-nested up to 3 levels), with initials/avatar, like counts, inline reply composer, resolve/reopen toggle and a root composer. Exports `flattenComments(comments)` returning `{comment, depth}` rows.

components.name: DatePicker
components.desc: Month-grid date picker with prev/next month navigation, ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` values, `min`/`max` day blocking, configurable `weekStartsOn` (0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday) and an optional Today shortcut.

components.name: KanbanBoard
components.desc: Drag-and-drop kanban board over flat `columns` + `cards` data (cards reference `columnId`), WIP `limit` counters, priority chips, tag chips, assignee initials, and ArrowLeft/ArrowRight keyboard moves.

components.name: SideDrawer
components.desc: Right- or left-anchored modal drawer with `sm`/`md`/`lg` widths, header + scrollable body + footer slots, Esc and backdrop dismissal, `role="dialog"`/`aria-modal` semantics.

components.name: AccountSwitcher
components.desc: Workspace switcher trigger showing the current account with a dropdown of all accounts (role · plan meta), add-account and sign-out actions, and outside-click/Escape dismissal.

components.name: SchedulerSlots
components.desc: Appointment slot picker grouped into morning/afternoon/evening with 12-hour labels, an open-slot count, blocked slots (lock icon + disabled), optional per-group notes and a timezone caption.

components.name: RichToolbar
components.desc: Formatting toolbar with separated button groups (dividers), icon-or-text glyph buttons, `active` toggle state (`aria-pressed`), disabled items and optional `shortcut` tooltips; `role="toolbar"` per group.

components.name: HeroSection
components.desc: Marketing hero with an eyebrow pill, headline, description, primary/secondary CTAs and a check-mark highlight row; centered or left-aligned.

components.name: FooterSection
components.desc: Marketing footer with a brand block + tagline, multi-column link lists, a social-icons row and a generated-or-custom copyright line.

components.name: TestimonialGrid
components.desc: Customer quote cards in a 2- or 3-column grid with star ratings, avatar-or-initials attribution and role/company meta; empty state included.

components.name: VoiceModePanel
components.desc: Voice-conversation surface with a four-state orb (idle / listening / thinking / speaking), pulsing halo, animated waveform bars, live transcript and reply lines, and an optional end-session action.

components.name: PromptLibrary
components.desc: Saved-prompt browser with free-text search across title/description/body/tags, category chips, favorite stars, monospace prompt previews and a Use action.

components.name: Tabs
components.desc: Accessible tab strip in underline or pills form with icons, badges, disabled tabs, controlled or uncontrolled selection and Arrow/Home/End keyboard navigation.

components.name: Accordion
components.desc: Disclosure list with optional icons and descriptions, single-open or `allowMultiple` behavior, animated chevron and `aria-expanded` + region semantics.

components.name: AvatarGroup
components.desc: Overlapping collaborator avatars with initials/image/user-icon fallbacks, +N overflow chip, optional presence dots and sm/md/lg sizes.

components.name: FilterBar
components.desc: Multi-select filter chips with dropdown option lists, per-option counts, active-count badges, Clear all, and outside-click/Escape dismissal.

components.name: Tooltip
components.desc: Hover/focus hint bubble positioned on any of four sides, linked to its trigger via `aria-describedby`, with pure-CSS fade and light-DOM children preserved.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.desc: Trail navigation with icon + label crumbs rendered as links, buttons or the current page, optional `maxItems` middle collapse and `aria-current="page"`.

components.name: Pagination
components.desc: Page-number navigation with ellipsis gaps, adjustable sibling count, optional first/last jump buttons, disabled bounds and `aria-current="page"`.

components.name: AlertBanner
components.desc: Inline status banner in info/success/warning/danger tones with optional action and dismiss buttons, using `role="status"` or `role="alert"` by severity.

components.name: ComboBox
components.desc: Searchable dropdown select with input filtering, ArrowUp/Down + Enter keyboard navigation, selected check, clear button, and outside-click/Escape dismissal.

components.name: Navbar
components.desc: Site navigation bar with multi-column mega menu panels (headings, icons, badges), plain links, and a CTA button; panels close on outside click or Escape.

components.name: ActivityFeed
components.desc: Timeline feed with six event kinds (event/comment/merge/deploy/flag/alert) mapped to tone chips, vertical connector line, monospace target pills, detail lines and relative timestamps.

components.name: UsageMeter
components.desc: Quota progress bar with 70%/90% threshold tones (indigo/amber/rose), percent + used/limit caption and optional remaining legend; safe at limit<=0.

components.name: ToggleSwitch
components.desc: Accessible switch (role=switch + aria-checked) with sm/md track sizes, optional label/description block, disabled state; fires change with { checked }.

components.name: Stepper
components.desc: Horizontal progress flow with complete/current/upcoming/error circle states, colored connectors, optional descriptions, click-to-jump for non-upcoming steps and a static read-only mode.

components.name: SearchInput
components.desc: Search field with controlled/uncontrolled modes, ⌘K shortcut hint chip, clear button once a query exists, loading spinner, Enter→search and Escape→clear semantics.

components.name: Tag
components.desc: Pill label in six tones (neutral/indigo/emerald/amber/rose/sky) with sm/md sizing, optional icon, removable variant (remove event) and clickable variant (tag-click event).

components.name: Modal
components.desc: Centered dialog over blurred backdrop with title/description header, body children, footer slot bar, close button, Escape/backdrop dismissal gated by dismissible and show-close flags.

components.name: ProfileHeader
components.desc: Profile page header with gradient cover and Pro pill, overlapping avatar (image or initials), status dot + text, stats as definition list, action buttons (primary/secondary/ghost), and tab row with aria-current.

components.name: BillingPanel
components.desc: Upgrade/billing panel with monthly/annual period toggle (aria-pressed), price block, feature checklist, line items as definition list with emphasized total row, primary CTA and info note.

components.name: StepSlider
components.desc: Discrete slider with per-stop buttons, filled track portion, ArrowLeft/Right/Home/End keyboard support on role=slider, highlight-from forward markers, and aria-valuetext from the step labels.

components.name: InboxList
components.desc: Inbox rows with unread dot, sender column, optional tag pill (rose/emerald/indigo), subject + snippet truncation, monospace date, active row highlight via active-id, and empty state.

components.name: ChangelogFeed
components.desc: Changelog aside with sparkles header, badge-toned entries (rose/emerald/indigo/amber) in a divided list, optional selectable rows, footer link button and empty state.

components.name: MetricStrip
components.desc: One-row KPI strip with divided clickable cells, optional leading icon, delta chip (trending-up emerald / trending-down rose / minus zinc) formatted `+N%` or custom deltaLabel, active cell highlight via activeIndex, and empty render without metrics.

components.name: RankList
components.desc: Ranked value list with peak-normalized inline ratio bars (4% minimum clamp), optional row icons, monospace value column, value-header column caption, maxItems truncation, optional row selection and empty state.

components.name: SideNav
components.desc: Grouped sidebar navigation with uppercase group titles, icon + truncated label entries, count badges (rose when >0, zinc when 0), active entry highlight via activeId and navigate event.

components.name: PageHeader
components.desc: Dashboard page header with title, emerald Live status pill, description, action button group (primary/secondary/ghost variants, optional icons) and underline tab nav with optional count badges; emits action and tab-change.

components.name: TimeframePicker
components.desc: Segmented timeframe presets with aria-pressed active state, previous/next period step buttons flanking a calendar range label, disabled state styling and change/step events.

components.name: WizardSteps
components.desc: Multi-step form wizard navigator with a vertical variant (numbered circles in done/active/todo states, connector lines, optional "(Optional)" tags, clickable completed steps for back navigation) and a bar variant ("N of M steps | Next: …" caption over a violet progressbar).

components.name: FormField
components.desc: Single labeled field skeleton with required star / "(Optional)" tag, error (alert icon + aria-invalid) or hint paragraph, N/M character counter, helper footer note and a default slot for the control (vanilla preserves live control state across re-renders).

components.name: GanttTimeline
components.desc: Table-shaped gantt chart with row labels (depth indentation), numbered column headers, task bars in four tones with optional progress overlay + percent label, a rose "today" marker line and optional task-click.

components.name: ApprovalCard
components.desc: Approval panel with stacked initials avatars + approved/total counter, due date row, decision line in approved (emerald) / rejected (rose) / pending (zinc) tones, optional note and Approve / Request change buttons (always rendered while decision is pending; request-change plus-button appears with an onRequestChange handler).

components.name: ResourceList
components.desc: Data-resource list rows with icon tile, name + monospace path, time label and kind badge (zinc/indigo/emerald/amber), header with total count, maxItems truncation, optional row selection and empty state.

components.name: SegmentBreakdownBars
components.desc: Headline metric + per-segment horizontal bars with value column and vs-total delta column (green/red pp), five bar tones and a share footer.

components.name: TargetGauge
components.desc: Semicircle KPI gauge with three zone bands (rose/amber/emerald), rotating needle, min/value-chip/max scale labels and an optional remaining line.

components.name: HealthDonutStats
components.desc: Card grid of conic-gradient donuts with center percent, per-slice legend with shares, captions and optional action buttons.

components.name: ForecastTrendChart
components.desc: Column trend that distinguishes solid actual bars from dashed forecast columns, with headline + delta badge (trending icon), note line and Actual/Forecast legend.

components.name: GroupedBarCompare
components.desc: Grouped two-bar comparison chart (violet estimated vs lime actual) with per-bar value labels, row names and a legend header.

components.name: QuoteMasonry
components.desc: Customer quote wall in a CSS-columns masonry (columns-1 sm:columns-2 lg:columns-3, break-inside-avoid) with curly quote marks (opt out via marked:false), uppercase name attribution and company badge.

components.name: SiteFooter
components.desc: Dark site footer (bg-zinc-950) with link columns, compliance badge circles (icon + emerald/amber/zinc status text) and a tagline + copyright bottom row.

components.name: MarqueeWall
components.desc: Alternating marquee rows of testimonial cards (keyframes marquee-scroll, odd rows reversed, cards doubled for seamless loop), hover pauses, `paused` attribute freezes, initials avatars, anonymous cards hide the handle.

components.name: OnboardingStepper
components.desc: Onboarding step chain (`>` separators, current step underlined indigo, progress bar at ((active+1)/total)%) with a segmented description control (role=tablist), example rows and a continue button.

components.name: FilterToolbar
components.desc: Filter chip toolbar with tone value pills (rose/emerald/amber/indigo), removable chips (× buttons), search input, list/grid view toggle (view:"none" hides it; React renders the toggle when viewOnChange is provided) and an action button.

components.name: OtpInput
components.desc: Verification code entry with six cells (auto-advance, backspace to previous, full-code paste auto-submit), error state (rose cells + alert line), Continue button and resend hint.

components.name: SearchTypeahead
components.desc: Page-level search with underline input, yellow <mark> substring highlighting, suggestion rows with mono type badges, grouped Top results with badges, footer hint + Help Center link and a clear button.

components.name: TourTooltip
components.desc: Anchored coach-mark card with triangular caret (top/bottom/none), Step N of M counter, light/dark themes, optional thumbs feedback, Previous hidden on step 1 and "Finish tour" on the last step.

components.name: CookieConsent
components.desc: Cookie preference dialog with collapsible <details> categories, "Always Active" locked rows, mono cookie-name lists and Accept All / Reject All / Confirm bulk actions emitting the accepted id list.

components.name: SettingsSideDrawer
components.desc: Side-anchored settings panel gated by the `open` attribute / `isOpen` prop (closed by default) over a fixed overlay with tab strip, setting rows (title + description + toggle/select/3-tone button controls) and a sticky footer (primary + secondary).

components.name: ClarifyQuestionCard
components.desc: Indigo-bordered clarification card with "?" badge, paging "N of M" (only when total > 1), answered state pill vs Enter-to-answer input and an emerald check + step label footer.

components.name: AgentTaskProgress
components.desc: Agent task progress with context banner, hint line, stacked step cards (done play icon / active spinner + substeps rail / pending chevron) and feedback + Refine/Next footer.

components.name: UsageQuotaCard
components.desc: Credit/quota meter in card variant (label, used-of-total, sky progress bar, upgrade line, full-width CTA) or emerald banner variant with inline CTA.

components.name: WorkspaceSwitcherMenu
components.desc: Workspace picker with gradient-initials or logo rows, "N members · You are an Admin/Editor" role lines, current highlight, create button and footer user row with logout.

components.name: AttachmentChip
components.desc: Compact file chip with kind tone badge (pdf=rose / doc=sky / csv=emerald / image=violet), mono glyph, name + size/meta line and round black X remove button.

components.name: DeploymentCard
components.desc: Single deployment record with status pill (building pulse / live / failed), mono commit sha + message line, source + relative time, Cancel deploy while building and Visit on terminal states.

components.name: LiveTailLogConsole
components.desc: Dark streaming log terminal with source-filter select, search input, Live tail follow toggle, timezone chip and severity-dot log lines (info/warn/error/success) capped by maxLines.

components.name: PipelineStageList
components.desc: Grouped CI pipeline accordion with phase headers (dashed circle or running spinner, current step, summed duration) and nested stage rows with mono status (Pending/Running/Completed/Failed) + per-stage durations.

components.name: ChangedFilesList
components.desc: PR changed-file card with collapsible header (title + total +N/−N diffstat), file rows (extension badge, mono path, status tag, per-file diffstat) and optional folder grouping.

components.name: ServiceStatusList
components.desc: Dev-environment service table (name, command code chip, running/stopped/failed/starting status, dark URL chip) with a verification checklist below (green check + code + detail or gray dot) and a duration footer.

components.name: FilterQueryBuilder
components.desc: Filter row builder with conjunction chips (where/and), field select, mono operator select (=, <>, >, <, ~, >=, <=), borderless value input and round X remove; "+ Add filter" ghost button with maxRows cap and "Clear filters" link.

components.name: ColumnVisibilityMenu
components.desc: Column visibility popover with "Showing X of Y" header, reset link, grip/lock/eye/reorder rows and optional apply-button mode (draft set + footer Apply).

components.name: StatusCountTabs
components.desc: Segmented tab strip with live counts that docks flush onto a table card (rounded-t-lg, border-b-0); active tab is white with inset bottom shadow.

components.name: EntityMultiSelectPicker
components.desc: Searchable checkbox multi-pick with avatar rows (image / rotating-tone initials / system dot tile), blue-50 selected rows and Cancel / "Insert results" footer.

components.name: FederatedSearchResultsPanel
components.desc: Full-text federated search overlay with source filter chips (toggle set, aria-pressed), snippet results with `<mark>` highlight and keyboard legend + "Press Tab to Ask AI" pill.

components.name: TimeSlotPicker
components.desc: Appointment booking with horizontal date chip strip, Morning/Afternoon/Evening grouped slot grids, availability counts (green N available / gray Fully booked) and indigo selected slot.

components.name: OrderTracker
components.desc: Order fulfillment tracker with dot-connector variant (green check dots, current ring, ETA line, Track shipment link) and bar variant (continuous progress + stage labels); canceled state goes all-gray with reason copy.

components.name: OrderSummaryPanel
components.desc: Checkout price breakdown with kind-toned rows (discount/fee green, total bold with top border, strikeValue, notes), applied promo chips, promo input (Enter/Apply) and dark pill CTA carrying amount + trust footer.

components.name: PaymentMethodCard
components.desc: Saved payment method with brand tile (VISA blue / MC black / AMEX sky), masked "Ending in" number, expiry, optional right-aligned amount, billing holder block and Change / "+ Add new payment" actions.

components.name: OrderCard
components.desc: Purchase-history card with gray header strip (Order# + Placed + View details pill), fulfillment verb + bold ETA + store line, six-state status badge, item thumbnails with qty/price and Buy it again / Total footer.

components.name: ColorPickerPopover
components.desc: Solid color picker with 6-row hue shade grid (selected ring + check, light swatches auto-gray check), live hex input, R/G/B channel inputs, eyedropper button, Document colors / Custom colors sections with dashed add tile.

components.name: EditorToolPalette
components.desc: Floating canvas tool picker with per-tool kbd number hints, blue active-tool highlight, selection count badge, horizontal pill or vertical rail orientation.

components.name: ShortcutCheatSheet
components.desc: Two-column grouped editor shortcut list with icons, markdown-syntax mono hints, keycap chip groups (bordered, subtle bottom shadow), live search filter with empty state.

components.name: ZoomControlBar
components.desc: Canvas viewport zoom in three variants (stepper −/%/+, dropdown with upward preset menu + Fit, slider with live label), optional undo/redo pair with divider, value clamped to [min,max].

components.name: AIInlineMenu
components.desc: Selection-anchored floating AI pill with sparkle badge chip (indigo or brand-emerald tone), action buttons with upward option menus, loading pulse + "Working…", red error border, dismiss round button.

components.name: EmptyStateStarter
components.desc: First-run "nothing here yet" starter with illustration slot, plain/dashed/card variants, md/sm sizes and solid/outline/link action styles.

components.name: AuthGatePrompt
components.desc: Soft contextual sign-in gate with SSO pill stack (white/#1877F2/dark tones), hairline divider, secondary outlined pill and "Not now" guest-skip link.

components.name: AuthSplitPanel
components.desc: Two-column welcome/auth shell — tinted brand panel (title + subtitle) or dark cover variant beside auth content, with blue legal footer links.

components.name: SuccessToast
components.desc: Self-dismissing mint confirmation toast (emerald-100 bg + dark-green check icon), fixed top-right or bottom-right, auto-dismiss timer reset on message change, close button.

components.name: EditableHeading
components.desc: Inline-editable object title — heading when idle, click switches to highlighted input (yellow bg + teal focus ring), Enter/blur commits, Esc cancels, breadcrumb + meta rows around it.

components.name: PlanComparisonTable
components.desc: Linear/Sprig style feature-comparison matrix — grouped section headers (dark band), per-cell check / note values ("G Suite + SAML"), highlighted plan column with tinted bg and per-plan CTA row.

components.name: UpgradeCheckoutPanel
components.desc: Clockwise/Attio style upgrade checkout — billing cadence segmented switch, seat stepper (min/max clamp), line-item summary with strikethrough list price, discount row, terms fine print and confirm CTA.

components.name: TrialBanner
components.desc: Later style trial countdown banner — days-left pill (pulses when <=3 days), plan-aware default message, unlock CTA, dismissible variant with X button and `show()` restore.

components.name: MembershipTierGrid
components.desc: Patreon style creator membership tiers — cover image, price + period, "Limited (N remaining)" stock note, trial CTA, badge chip and perk bullet list.

components.name: AddonPicker
components.desc: User Interviews/Attio style add-on selector — checkbox rows with price or "Let's talk" contact link, disabled rows, checked indigo fill and running total footer.

components.name: ImageGenGallery
components.desc: AI image studio — prompt bar with Generate CTA, tile grid (aspect ratios, model badges), hover actions (download / variant / delete) and pulsing generating skeleton.

components.name: SharedChatViewer
components.desc: public read-only page for a shared AI conversation — brand header with meta, user/assistant bubbles and a bottom "Try it yourself" CTA bar.

components.name: MemoryPanel
components.desc: ChatGPT-style memory manager — remembered facts with source captions, inline editing (Save/Cancel), per-row delete, add input and clear-all.

components.name: ConnectorGrid
components.desc: "Apps & Connectors" integration panel — icon cards with description, Connect / Connected toggle buttons and a live N/M connected badge.

components.name: ModelComparePane
components.desc: LMArena style side-by-side model comparison — shared prompt chip, two model output columns (streaming dots / error state) and an A / Tie / B vote bar.

components.name: SystemPromptEditor
components.desc: system prompt workspace — version chip, Saved/Unsaved dirty state, live token estimate, {{variable}} chips and a temperature slider (0–2); Save disabled while clean.

components.name: ToolSchemaEditor
